data.name: Lamiah
data.gender_notes: Lamiah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'L-M-H', meaning 'to soften', 'to be gentle', or 'to care for'. This name is a beautiful reminder of the tenderness and nurturing nature of Allah (swt) towards His creation, especially mothers who embody this quality. The name Lamiah carries the meaning “A gentle and tender mother” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lamiah usually hope their child will grow to embody a gentle and tender mother and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the tender love and care of Allah (swt) towards His creation.
data.etymology: Lamiah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A gentle and tender mother.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lamiah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
